messages:
ingrid: FYI discovered another parity mismatch — Node SDK isn't forwarding query params used by our routing layer (priority, timeout_ms). Customer sampleapp relies on priority-based queuing and they're seeing timeouts.

sam: ouch. is this the same root cause as the python drop?

ingrid: similar symptom but different code path. Node SDK builds the URL with querystring.stringify on a sanitized params object and we filter unknown keys. That filter was meant to protect us from typos but it's too aggressive. Repro: 

# curl (works)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?priority=high&timeout_ms=12000" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"ping"}'

# node (silent)
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW });
await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-7b', input: 'ping', priority: 'high', timeout_ms: 12000 });
```

jess: does the server surface any header that shows missing params? any logs?

ingrid: server logs show requests hitting default queue, no querystring. No error returned by SDK. This is very bad for sample apps and onboarding because curl demos behave differently from the SDK.

elena: we should avoid silent-dropping. Options: 1) add explicit queryParams param to SDK call, 2) whitelist known params and throw on unknowns in debug mode, 3) include a runtime warning when we drop anything. I'm leaning toward explicit queryParams to be explicit.

sam: also check retry/backoff parity. Last time we had drift in jitter patterns between client SDK and our proxy which affected throttling behavior.

ingrid: checked: Node SDK retries 3 times with fixed 200ms increments for 429s. Proxy does exponential backoff with randomized jitter (base 100ms, factor 2). We'll need to align to avoid clients amplifying load.

jess: plan suggestion: implement queryParams object on client.generate, deprecate permissive kwargs, log at WARN if callers pass unknown top-level keys, and switch retry to exponential + jitter with same params as proxy. Add unit tests that assert URL includes querystring and an integration microbenchmark showing latency under throttling.

elena: +1. Also update examples/node/generate.js and onboarding quickstart to use queryParams so docs match real behavior.

sam: assignable tasks? estimate?

ingrid: I can take the Node SDK change (PR + tests) today, jess can add example and microbenchmark, elena will update docs. CI tests will include mocked 429 sequence to verify backoff.

devex-bot: Created issue #4581: "node-sdk: queryParams option + retry parity" assigned to ingrid, jess, elena.

sam: timeline? customer patch requested.

ingrid: patch branch today, PR by EOD, release candidate after review. If reviewers are quick we can ship tomorrow.

jess: i'll prepare the example diff and a tiny perf script that toggles priority to show queueing impact.

elena: I'll also add a short note in the quickstart: "curl vs SDK can differ if query params aren't passed — use queryParams or explicit flags".

sam: thanks team. another reminder that SDK demos must be first-class citizens of onboarding. :raised_hands:
